title: Partial transformation
summary: Shifting only part of the body.

claims.text: Besides moving between the five forms, a werewolf can change only some body parts, or carry one trait of a form into another; it takes hard concentration and can hurt.
Typical uses are hidden claws or fangs in Homid until a guarded target is close, a wolf’s night sight or scenting snout on a human face, or human colour vision for a Lupus.
Many Garou never bother, since a full shift is easier; those who use it want subtlety, or wear clothing that is not dedicated and would be lost in a full change.
Kailindo fighters depend on quick partial changes to boost their combat.

title: High and low Gnosis
summary: An optional rule for strong or weak spiritual energy.

claims.text: One optional way to play it: a Gnosis of 8 or more counts as high, and 3 or less as low.
With high Gnosis, each point past seven takes one off the difficulty of spirit rolls (a fetish or a sideways step, say); low Gnosis raises them by one per point below four.
Difficulties changed this way stay between 3 and 9, and each troupe may decide whether to use the rule at all.
Taught almost only within the Society of Erichthonius and thought heretical by most Garou, the Gift lets a metis set aside the inborn deformity for a time.
It leaves battle scars and deformities caused by Gifts or other powers untouched.
Only an ancestor-spirit who was metis in life can teach it, and a level five form that moves the deformity onto another Garou is rumoured.

title: Hibernation
summary: A level four Gift of Bear.

claims.text: Only Bear or one of Bear’s avatars teaches this rare Gift, which lets a werewolf sink into a dormancy that holds off hunger and other bodily needs and stops ageing.
The werewolf needs a quiet, dark place and eight undisturbed hours; the roll is Stamina + Survival at difficulty 7, spending at least one Gnosis and one Willpower that do not return while asleep.
A botch throws the Garou straight into frenzy.

title: Rite of Succession
summary: A level three rite for taking a sept post.

claims.text: The rite marks a Garou taking up a post of authority in the sept, with the whole sept gathered as witnesses while the ritemaster lists the newcomer’s deeds.
The successor kills a fitting human or animal sacrifice before the ritemaster, everyone eats a portion, and the ritemaster claws a glyph into one of its bones as a token of the new office.
